svg.text: EnergyHub — Current Monolithic Architecture
One integrated product: EH app + Family companion + household HA configuration
INPUTS · inverter and battery
PI30MAX serial telemetry and verified commands
Optional read-only PV2 on the same serial lock
BMS via the installed read-only sensor path
No assumed support for arbitrary inverters
EH APP · one Python runtime
main.py orchestrates policy and persistence
Reserve, night and pre-outage charging
First-floor heat-pump policy and ownership
Only its controller writes inverter settings
HOME ASSISTANT · native execution
Native plug overload and outage SOC protection
HP1 bridge, schedules, profiles and helpers
Mapped devices, network settings and dashboards
No duplicate Python plug-switching authority
FAMILY APP · reporting and evidence
Forecast, weather and outage-source adapters
Morning reports, grid events and diagnostics
Feeds normalized planning evidence to EH
Messages do not directly control hardware
CONNECTIONS · local integration
MQTT carries telemetry, inputs and HP intents
HA services execute mapped device actions
HP acknowledgements and journals retain context
Native plug actions have separate saved-state logic
PRODUCT BOUNDARY · still monolithic
Household rules still span Python and HA YAML
Not a universal configurable Core/Custom product
Threat Monitor is a separate project
AI, EV and export optimization are not shipped
Architecture is not being split here. Diagrams describe current responsibilities, not a proposed version 4 design.
